Traditional platforms like PayPal and Stripe are inaccessible in many regions, leaving creators in countries like Nigeria and Venezuela searching for viable alternatives. This post explores the infrastructure options available for accepting Bitcoin for ebook sales without relying on these conventional payment systems, ultimately positioning NOWPayments as a superior choice for creators looking to maximize their profits and maintain control over their sales.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-15. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Bitcoin ebook

When considering platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, many creators are unaware of the hidden costs involved. Both options come with hefty transaction fees, often around 10%. In contrast, NOWPayments offers a streamlined approach with only a 0.5% fee, ensuring that creators retain a larger portion of their sales revenue. This cost-effectiveness is vital for maximizing earnings, particularly for creators with tight margins. Additionally, the architecture of NOWPayments allows for seamless integration into various frameworks, providing the flexibility and control that creators need in a constrained financial landscape.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Restricted countries often face barriers that limit their ability to use conventional payment processors. Platforms like PayPal and Stripe may block access entirely, leaving creators with few options. NOWPayments, however, operates globally and does not impose such restrictions, making it an ideal solution for creators in these regions. By utilizing NOWPayments, you can accept payments in multiple cryptocurrencies without the need for extensive verification processes. This allows you to operate your business freely, regardless of your geographical constraints, and empowers you to reach customers worldwide.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Speed is crucial when it comes to payment processing, especially for digital products. With NOWPayments, transactions occur almost instantaneously once confirmed on the blockchain. In comparison, platforms like Gumroad may take days to release funds, along with high fees that can accumulate quickly. For example, with 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between these two platforms amounts to a staggering $921 retained in your pocket. This efficiency not only enhances your cash flow but also elevates the customer experience, as buyers receive instant access to their purchased ebooks.
NOWPayments keeps your fees low at just 0.5%.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership over your sales infrastructure is paramount. Platforms like Gumroad retain control over your customer data, which can be a significant drawback. With the Complete Builder Kit from COREMERCH, you own everything after deployment, ensuring your data remains yours. The automated delivery of your ebooks via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script means you can focus on creating content while the system handles sales and distribution. This level of automation not only saves time but also reduces the risk of errors, allowing you to scale your operations efficiently.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Selecting the right architecture depends on your specific needs as a creator. If you need a quick setup for a small number of products, the Sovereign Starter Stack may suffice. However, for those looking to scale and offer a wider range of ebooks and courses, the Edge Commerce Stack provides a more robust solution with additional features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. Understanding your long-term goals and the volume of transactions you expect will guide your choice, as each stack is designed to cater to different levels of complexity and needs.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

If you want to sell ebooks online without using PayPal or Stripe, consider platforms like NOWPayments for accepting Bitcoin. This platform allows you to retain more of your earnings while providing a seamless checkout experience for your customers. You can easily set up an automated delivery system for your digital products, ensuring instant access upon payment confirmation.
Own your customer data outright; it's yours after deployment.

For creators exploring how to sell ebooks and other digital products without traditional platform fees, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything needed to build, deploy, and scale your own sovereign digital commerce stack. This solution enables you to operate independently from restrictive payment processors. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell my ebook without using Gumroad?

Consider using NOWPayments to accept Bitcoin directly. This approach allows you to avoid the high fees associated with Gumroad while retaining full control over your customer data and payment processing.
What’s the best way to handle digital downloads?

Utilize Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automated delivery of your digital products. This ensures customers receive their purchases instantly and reduces the administrative burden on you.
Can I accept multiple cryptocurrencies for my ebook sales?
Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a broader audience and maximize your sales opportunities without the limitations of traditional payment processors.
What if I am in a restricted country?
NOWPayments operates globally and does not impose restrictions based on your location. This makes it an ideal choice for creators in countries where traditional payment processors are unavailable.
Is there ongoing support after I deploy my stack?
Yes, COREMERCH offers 30 days of support after deployment, ensuring you have the assistance needed to troubleshoot and optimize your ecommerce setup.
